*
 Mr. Piyush Shah a/w. Mr. Aditya Tayade for the Applicants
 Mr. A.R. Patil Addl. G.P. for the Respondent No.1.

** * *
 Coram : M. M. Sathaye, 
 Dated : 4th September 2
 P.C.:
1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
Office note indicates that the Respondent No. 2-MIDC is duly served.
Nobody appeared for the Respondent No. 2.
Learned Counsel for the Applicants states that copy of the Application is already served upon AGP office for the State.
No reply is filed.
2. This is an Application for restoration of substantive First Appeal which is dismissed for not filing the private paper book within the stipulated time under the conditional order dated 04/03/2011.
There is a delay of 11 years and 187 days in filing the Application for which explanation is offered in para nos. 5 to 9 of the Application.

3. It is contended that at the relevant time, when the conditional order was passed, the concerned Advocate handling the matter was required to Manik Rabha Gawari Since Deceased ... vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr. on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179412978/
1 21.IA.17215.2023.doc take timely steps, which were not taken and nothing was informed.

sentences.text: It is further contended that the Applicants, on their own contacted their local Advocate to know about the progress in the matter and thereafter the local Advocate searched for necessary information and found out from the official website that the first appeal is dismissed due to some non-compliance.
It is further stated that thereafter the Applicant's local Advocate inquired with the High Court Advocate and it was informed that High Court Advocate has expired in 2016 itself.
The Applicant thereafter, through new Advocate, searched the papers and it was found that the Appeal is dismissed.

It is also stated that annexures to the Appeal compilation were destroyed as per applicable Bombay High Court Appellate Side Rules, 1960 and only certified copies of the Appeal Memo could be obtained.

entities.text: Bombay High Court Appellate Side Rules, 1960
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is stated that necessary information and documents could be obtained for necessary action as late as in September 2023 and thereafter the Application is immediately filed in October 2023.
4. No reply is filed opposing the Application or controverting the statements made therein on oath.
It appears that there was complete lack of communication between the Applicants and their earlier Advocate.
It further appears that Applicants were relying upon their earlier Advocate for necessary compliance, which was not made.
In the interregnum, the earlier Advocate died.
5. Record indicates that Appeal is arising out of Land Acquisition Reference, which was dismissed.

It appears that land admeasuring 8H 34R owned by the Applicant's predecessors, was acquired for the Respondent No. 2 - MIDC and certain compensation was paid by the Special Land Acquisition Officer about which the reference was filed.

Considering the nature of dispute involved and the fact that substantial First Appeal was dismissed for technical ground of not filing private paper book, which appears to be the result of lack of timely steps by concerned Advocate, the parties cannot be permitted to suffer for the mistake of their Advocate.
Considering the case of lack of knowledge about the conditional order, delay appears to be sufficiently explained.
7. In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, sufficient cause is made out for delay condonation and case is made out for restoration.
8. Learned Counsel for the Applicants submits that since it is an old matter and the record of the High Court was destroyed, he needs longer time to prepare private paper book.

9. Subject to the Applicants filing private paper book within a period of ten weeks from today, the Application is allowed; delay is condoned; effect of conditional order dated 04/03/2011 is set aside and appeal is restored to the file.
10. The Application is disposed of in above terms.
All concerned to act on duly authenticated or digitally signed copy of this order.
